# REQ-023 LAN group voice design research

Proposal for discussion. No prototype or runtime measurements. Requirement: ~/Downloads/requirements-intake.md:843. Membership findings: req-023-admission.md.

## Media flow

Use a full mesh of independent bidirectional WebRTC connections (RFC 8834 §3, RFC 7667 §3.9). Each joining endpoint requests microphone access once, adds the same local audio track to each RTCPeerConnection, and receives one remote track per connected endpoint. WebRTC negotiates the codec (prefer Opus where supported), encrypts each leg with DTLS-SRTP, handles jitter and decodes incoming audio. Play each remote track through its own audio element; the local playback path mixes the sources. Assemble a one-track MediaStream when the track event carries no stream. Keep local mic and remote playback separate. If per-peer gains and output limiting prove necessary, route one source per remote track through its own GainNode into a shared master and AudioContext destination, with exactly one playback path. Test simultaneous speech, speaker echo, and blocked autoplay in the installed WebViews. Muting the shared local track silences it across all peers; deafen changes local output only. Stopping capture and closing all connections are separate responsibilities.

Sources: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8834.html, https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7667.html#section-3.9, https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7874, https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/, https://www.w3.org/TR/webaudio/, https://webkit.org/blog/7763/a-closer-look-into-webrtc/. Existing implementation: frontend/src/store/calls.ts:130–269 and crates/mesh-talk-core/src/node/call.rs:52–127.

## Control plane

Candidate: initiator temporarily owns meeting advertisement, bounded roster and join ordering while media flows directly. Use authenticated live Noise for start/join/leave and per-pair SDP signaling. Verify the specific group's accepted membership and certified device at admission and at each receiving endpoint before applying SDP or sending audio. Bind messages to group, meeting, remote device and connection generation. A deterministic offerer per pair prevents normal simultaneous-offer races. Keep media and signaling out of chat history and post-office delivery. Use host ICE candidates for the LAN prototype; test actual reachability across wired/Wi-Fi and client isolation, and surface per-peer failure.

An initiator-owned roster provides a simple hard capacity limit and duplicate-device arbitration. On explicit end or coordinator lease expiry, close all connections and stop capture. Continuing and admitting new callers after initiator loss requires a defined authority handoff or replicated roster with partition semantics. Continuing existing legs while suspending new joins is a distinct option. Remote revocation is only observable after signed group control reaches a peer. Close affected legs when it does; define the stale-view/partition cutoff before promising a bound.

## Cost and alternatives

With N participants, N(N-1)/2 independent connections and N(N-1) directional streams when everyone sends. At four participants, three send and three receive legs per endpoint. At an illustrative 32 kb/s codec payload per leg, each endpoint sends and receives 96 kb/s of payload per direction (excludes headers, encryption, control, retries, and Wi-Fi overhead). Encoding work and effective bitrate are runtime properties, not guaranteed to be shared simply because capture is shared.

A LAN SFU reduces sender upload to one stream but creates a forwarding dependency and changes the media trust boundary. An MCU terminates, decodes and mixes audio, then encodes recipient output, normally excluding the recipient's own voice. Both impose host-loss and deployment costs. See RFC 7667 §§3.6–3.7 and RFC 8834 §3.

## Validation before expanding scope

Test 2/3/4 endpoints on physical LAN and applicable native desktop WebViews. Measure time from join to first received audio and separately acoustic mouth-to-ear latency; RTT is not a substitute. Collect per-leg bitrate, loss, jitter, jitter buffer delay and concealed samples where exposed; measure CPU, memory and idle recovery externally. Verify overlapping speech, mute/deafen, mic permission denial, output playback failure, member removal, network loss, host exit and repeated join/leave with full resource cleanup. Scope stats collection to active diagnostics. No thresholds or participant capacity have been validated. Source: https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc-stats/.
EOF

### 推流、拉流和混音

以 A、B、C、D 四人开会为例，A 端的流程是这样的。

1. **加入。** A 点击加入，客户端确认 A 的认证设备属于该群当前已接受的成员，并绑定到这一次会议。通过准入后，请求麦克风权限，拿到一条本地音轨。[群权限调研](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-023/tmp/req-023-admission.md)
2. **推流。** A 分别与 B、C、D 建立三条双向 WebRTC 连接，同一条麦克风音轨通过 `addTrack()` 加入三条连接。每对设备通过现有直连 Noise 信令交换 SDP 和 ICE 候选。WebRTC 协商编解码器，优先验证 Opus，并通过 DTLS-SRTP 加密每条媒体链路。群聊天记录和邮局都不承载音频。[WebRTC 规范](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/) · [WebRTC 音频要求](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7874) · [现有通话信令](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-023/crates/mesh-talk-core/src/node/call.rs:52)
3. **拉流。** 同一条双向连接可以同时收音。A 从三条连接的 `ontrack` 分别收到 B、C、D 的音轨。WebRTC 按连接处理收包、抖动缓冲和解码。A 收到的音轨只进入本地播放路径，发给其他人的始终是 A 的麦克风音轨。[WebRTC 规范](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/) · [WebRTC 媒体传输](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8834.html)
4. **混音播放。** 首版可以给每条远端音轨绑定一个 `<audio>` 播放器，交给本机播放链路叠加。B、C 同时说话，A 就同时听见两人，且 A 的麦克风不会接到自身扬声器。若实测需要每人独立增益或总输出限幅，再把各音轨接到一个 `AudioContext`，按「每路增益 → 总输出 → 扬声器」处理。静音控制自己发出的音轨，关闭收听只控制本机输出。外放回声和播放授权需要在安装包里的实际 WebView 验证。[Web Audio 规范](https://www.w3.org/TR/webaudio/) · [WebKit 播放策略](https://webkit.org/blog/7763/a-closer-look-into-webrtc/) · [现有播放器](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-023/frontend/src/features/chat/CallDialog.tsx:116)

### 去中心化的关键在于分开讨论媒体和会议状态

**媒体用全互连。** 四人总共六条双向连接，每台设备最多三路发送、三路接收。如果用每路 32 kb/s 的编码净荷作估算，每台约上行 96 kb/s、下行 96 kb/s，实际还要加上传输开销。复用采集也不保证 WebView 会复用编码工作，因此要测 CPU、功耗和 Wi‑Fi 下的重叠说话。局域网内的客户端隔离或防火墙也可能造成 A 能连 B、却连不上 C，界面需要按成员呈现连接状态。[RTP 拓扑](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7667.html) · [现有网络边界](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-023/docs/help/topics/calls.md:56)

如果将来参与人数上升，可以再比较 LAN 内的 **SFU** 和 **MCU**。SFU 把每位说话者上传的音轨转发给其他人，接收端继续本地混音。MCU 在中间设备解码、混音、再编码，通常为每个接收端排除自己的声音。两种方案都会让中间设备的可达性、掉线和媒体信任边界成为产品问题。3–4 人是当前原型的**测量起点**，暂未形成上线容量承诺。[RFC 7667 §§3.6–3.7](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7667.html#section-3.6)
